+def branch_log(repo, branch):
+    """Return the one-line log of a branch name sent by the web client."""
+    out = subprocess.run(
+        f"git -C {repo} log --oneline {branch}",
+        shell=True,
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+    )
+    return out.stdout.splitlines()
